editorial.blurb: Querrepario serves authentic Guerrero-style Mexican food made with care—from hand-rolled tortillas to house-made chorizo—in a warm, welcoming spot near Midway.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the quesabirria tacos and dip them in the savory consomé; ask your server for recommendations on seasonal specials like the cookie butter latte.

topDishes.note: flavorful with fresh avocado, rice and beans
tortilla perfectly balanced, everything tastes fresh
